CLIP (with atom IDs): E09.011 | 00:19.00-00:22.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E09.012 | 00:19.40-00:21.80 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (venomous, furious) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
[Hard cut]
E08.006 | 00:12.00-00:17.00 | CAM | Close-up on the widow's jaw tightening.
E08.007 | 00:12.40-00:16.20 | DLG | MARA (quiet, defiant) | "Why does the sea give back only what it wants?"
E08.008 | 00:17.00-00:21.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E08.009 | 00:17.40-00:20.44 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (gruff, afraid) | "Your father paid me to watch over you."
E08.010 | 00:19.50-00:21.00 | SFX | The crowd gasps.
E08.011 | 00:21.00-00:24.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Mara as the lamp flickers behind them.
E08.012 | 00:24.00-00:28.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Selene and Tobin, the space between them charged.
E08.013 | 00:24.20-00:28.00 | ACT | Selene throws open the shutters; the storm floods in.
E08.014 | 00:24.40-00:27.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (cold, venomous) | "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
E08.015 | 00:28.00-00:34.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E08.016 | 00:28.20-00:34.00 | ACT | Mara kneels on the slick quay boards.
E08.017 | 00:34.00-00:37.00 | CAM | Close-up on the widow's hands gripping the rail.
E08.018 | 00:34.40-00:36.80 | DLG | SELENE (mocking, shrill) | "Smile, sister. It is your last night of freedom."
E08.019 | 00:37.00-00:43.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Corin's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E08.020 | 00:37.40-00:40.82 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (kind, gruff) | "I saw who slipped the ring into your shawl."
E08.021 | 00:43.00-00:46.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E08.022 | 00:43.40-00:45.80 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (gruff, afraid) | "Your father paid me to watch over you."
E08.023 | 00:46.00-00:48.00 | CAM | Close-up on Selene's jaw tightening.
E08.024 | 00:48.00-00:54.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from Tobin toward Selene.
E08.025 | 00:48.40-00:51.06 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (triumphant, pompous) | "The council has already decided her fate."
E08.026 | 00:54.00-00:57.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E08.027 | 00:54.20-00:57.00 | ACT | the Mayor tears the lace veil and lets it fall.
E08.028 | 00:54.40-00:56.80 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (silken, furious) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
